page.overview:
Who is Viltrumite Executioner 1?

Allen the Alien (attempted victim; killer) Battle Beast

2x08 "I Thought You Were Stronger" (Debut)|last appearance=3x04 "You Were My Hero"}}

The Viltrumite Executioner 1 was a minor antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 2 to 3. He was one of the executioners of "The Great Nolan".

He was a Viltrumite warrior of the Viltrum Empire, dedicated to aiding the Viltrumite mission to make it the only empire in the universe. Ultimately, he was killed by both Nolan and Allen.
